semantic_review_method: Sequential semantic read of every frozen record; qualifying dimensions recorded sparsely.

interpretation_constraints.literary_domain: Puram is treated as work-level classification unless source-local evidence is narrower.
interpretation_constraints.tinai_turai: Recorded only when source metadata/text supports it; missing classification is not invented.
interpretation_constraints.named_entities: Source-printed name/entity candidates only; no external historical identity resolution.
interpretation_constraints.textual_intertextual_relationships: Recorded only for source-visible textual/allusive relations.
interpretation_constraints.empty_cell_semantics: No qualifying evidence is currently recorded in the reviewed source record; not historical absence.
